features: Pregame opponent defensive allowance history, shrunk toward FBS training mean; home-field flag. No separate SOS.
limitations: Pilot covers 13 advanced-endpoint metrics rather than complete 38/41; 2026 is partial; games are used in team-season chronological order; benchmark uses v15 coefficients on independent prior allowance proxy, not exact production v15; raw z-scores use training FBS game SD; the additional residual SD scores use 2025 holdout prediction-error SD; no external venue or roster controls.
